featureConstraints: Account name is globally unique and cannot be reused while the source exists
Lifecycle, soft-delete, immutability and network rules are not copied by data tools

documentationSources.title: Relocate Azure Storage Account to another region

requiredEvidence: Confirm the resource's current configuration via authenticated inspection before relying on this rule.
risks: Large data volumes extend the sync window; egress cost
Applications hold the account name/endpoint and keys/SAS — connection reconfiguration required
mitigations: Use incremental AzCopy sync passes, freeze writes, then final sync and reconciliation (object counts, sizes, MD5 where available)
validation: Object counts and total bytes reconcile within tolerance
Access tier and encryption settings match
rollback: Source account remains intact until applications are verified against the destination
crossTenantImplications: Direct cross-tenant move is not an ARM operation; the supported native path is transferring the whole subscription to the destination directory, after which tenant-bound objects (role assignments, managed identities, Key Vault access, Entra-integrated auth) must be rebuilt.
If the subscription cannot be transferred, recreate in the destination tenant and migrate data separately.
